literature.headline_zh: 麻疹病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期麻疹病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 来自受感染动物的麻疹病毒序列含有独特的突变特征,包括 CDV、CeMV 和一种编码非功能性 M 蛋白和超融合 F 蛋白的 PDV 序列,类似于 SSPE 患者中 麻疹病毒 (MeV) 的突变特征。 [10.1186/s42522-026-00250-3]
在 MMR 总覆盖率 82% 和两剂完成 80% 的基线情景下,平均控制繁殖数为 $R_{c,m}=1.3537$,表明 暴发 控制的人群保护不足。在检查的所有完成场景中,将 MMR 总覆盖率提高到 90% 将 $R_{c,m}$ 降低到 1 以下。 [10.1007/s13721-026-00899-w]

记录有 疫苗接种 的患者的 麻疹 特异性 IgM 水平显着较高。从入院到第 3 天,两组的 IL-1β 均显着下降,IL-10 显着升高,但组间 IL-1β 没有差异。在两组中均观察到 IL-1β 和 IL-10 之间存在强正相关性,而在没有 疫苗接种 记录的患者中,IgM 与相对淋巴细胞百分比呈正相关。 [Immunopathogenetic Features of Measles in Adults: Association of Vaccination Status with Measles-Specific IgM Levels and]
结果表明,麻疹 和百日咳仍然是重大的公共卫生挑战,最近的数据显示,麻疹 计划在减轻疾病负担方面有效,但很容易受到干扰,这凸显了恢复能力的必要性。 [10.1038/s41591-026-04690-2]
Cq 重复性变异系数 (CV) 范围为 0.53% 至 1.68%,总再现性 CV 范围为 1.10% 至 2.37%。所有 Tm CV 均≤0.20%。此外,所有 18 种干扰物和 16 种微生物交叉反应物均符合预定的验收标准。 [10.1016/j.mcp.2026.102090]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Between 1990 and 2019, global measles incidence and mortality declined by approximately 80% and 90%, respectively, but rebounded sharply after 2020, with 15.6 million cases and 118,000 deaths estimated in 2023 (+40% and +12% increases, respectively, between 2019 and 2023). [10.1038/s41591-026-04661-7]

The morbillivirus sequences from the infected animals contained unique mutational signatures, with CDV, CeMV, and one PDV sequence encoding nonfunctional M proteins and hyperfusogenic F proteins, similar to the mutational profile of measles virus (MeV) in SSPE patients. [10.1186/s42522-026-00250-3]

Under the baseline scenario of 82% total MMR coverage and 80% two-dose completion, the mean controlled reproduction number was $R_{c,m}=1.3537$, indicating insufficient population protection for outbreak control. Increasing total MMR coverage to 90% reduced $R_{c,m}$ below one in all completion scenarios examined. [10.1007/s13721-026-00899-w]

Patients with documented vaccination had significantly higher measles-specific IgM levels. IL-1β decreased and IL-10 increased significantly from admission to day 3 in both groups, with no between-group differences in IL-1β. [Immunopathogenetic Features of Measles in Adults: Association of Vaccination Status with Measles-Specific IgM Levels and]

The results indicate that measles and pertussis remain significant public health challenges, with recent data showing that vaccination programs have been effective in reducing disease burden but are vulnerable to disruptions, underscoring the need for resilience. [10.1038/s41591-026-04690-2]

Between 1990 and 2019, global measles incidence and mortality declined by approximately 80% and 90%, respectively, but rebounded sharply after 2020, with 15.6 million cases and 118,000 deaths estimated in 2023 (+40% and +12% increases, respectively, between 2019 and 2023). The morbillivirus sequences from the infected animals contained unique mutational signatures, with CDV, CeMV, and one PDV sequence encoding nonfunctional M proteins and hyperfusogenic F proteins, similar to the mutational profile of measles virus (MeV) in SSPE patients. papers.title: Global and regional burden of measles and vaccine coverage among children under 5 years, 1990−2023: a Global Burden of Disease Study
papers.abstract: Measles remains a leading cause of vaccine-preventable burden among children, particularly in low-income settings. Despite decades of progress, there are indications of measles resurgence due to stagnation in vaccine coverage. Here, using the Global Burden of Diseases, Injuries and Risk Factors Study (GBD) 2023, we systematically assessed measles incidence, mortality, disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) and vaccine coverage (measles-containing vaccine 1 (MCV1) and measles-containing vaccine 2 (MCV2)) among children under 5 years of age across 204 countries and territories from 1990 to 2023. Between 1990 and 2019, global measles incidence and mortality declined by approximately 80% and 90%, respectively, but rebounded sharply after 2020, with 15.6 million cases and 118,000 deaths estimated in 2023 (+40% and +12% increases, respectively, between 2019 and 2023). Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia continue to bear the highest burden. Global MCV1 coverage rose from 67.2% in 1990 to 83.6% in 2019 but stalled and declined slightly to 81.0% by 2023; MCV2 coverage increased from 14.4% in 1990 to 68.4% in 2019 and reached 71.4% by 2023. Several regions remain well below the Immunization Agenda 2030 (IA2030) target of 90% coverage. The recent measles resurgence underscores the fragility of global immunization progress and the urgent need to restore routine vaccination, close immunity gaps and strengthen outbreak preparedness.

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 撒哈拉以南非洲和南亚仍然承受着最高的负担。最近的“麻疹”死灰复燃凸显了全球免疫进展的脆弱性,迫切需要恢复常规“麻疹”、缩小免疫差距和加强“暴发”准备工作。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果警告说,尽管过去取得了成功,麻疹 仍然是一个重大的公共卫生问题,特别是在 疫苗 覆盖率较低的地区。复苏凸显了需要持续努力维持和提高 疫苗接种 费率。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 一些地区仍远低于 2030 年免疫议程 (IA2030) 90% 覆盖率的目标。研究设计的局限性和某些地区漏报的可能性可能会影响结果的准确性。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to examine the lessons learned from the West Texas measles outbreak regarding public health leadership and response strategies. The background highlighted the resurgence of measles in the region and the need for improved public health management.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a retrospective analysis of the West Texas measles outbreak conducted between 2023 and 2024. It focused on the outbreak's impact on public health leadership and included data from multiple local health departments.
analysis.methods: The methods involved reviewing outbreak data, analyzing public health response strategies, and evaluating the effectiveness of leadership decisions during the outbreak. The study relied on qualitative analysis of reports and interviews with public health officials.
analysis.main_results: The results indicated that the outbreak underscored the importance of coordinated public health leadership, timely vaccination campaigns, and community engagement. It also revealed gaps in communication and resource allocation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as a call for stronger leadership frameworks in public health emergencies. The novelty lies in the emphasis on leadership as a critical factor in outbreak management.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of more robust public health leadership protocols and improve preparedness for future outbreaks. They also highlight the need for better communication strategies in health crises.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include its reliance on qualitative data and the potential for bias in self-reported outcomes. The evidence is moderate due to the descriptive nature of the analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the West Texas measles outbreak to highlight the importance of public health leadership in managing such events. The authors conducted a retrospective analysis of the outbreak's impact on leadership and response strategies, revealing gaps in communication and resource allocation. The findings emphasize the need for stronger leadership frameworks and better community engagement in public health emergencies. While the study provides valuable insights, its reliance on qualitative data and potential for bias limits the strength of the evidence, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

papers.title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
papers.abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.

source_records.abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
source_records.journal: CAUCHY: Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

papers.abstract_zh: 麻疹仍然是印度尼西亚的重大公共卫生挑战,尤其是在疫苗接种覆盖率异质性和免疫力下降的地区。本研究开发并分析了一个针对麻疹传播的易感-接种-感染-康复(SVIR)分组模型,该模型纳入了免疫力下降的因素。基本再生数R0是通过下一代矩阵方法推导的,并且通过李雅普诺夫函数严格证明了无病平衡态和地方性平衡态的全局稳定性。模型参数是从2023年Sidoarjo市每周的监测数据中使用粒子群优化(PSO)、扩展卡尔曼滤波、最大似然估计和最小二乘法进行估计,并通过平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)进行评估。PSO方法实现了最低的MAPE(11.17%),优于其他方法。估计的R0 = 0.668确认了无病状态。归一化敏感性分析确定疫苗效力是最关键的参数;疫苗效力下降至0 .75会使R0接近临界阈值,任何进一步的减少都会使系统进入地方性状态。这些发现强调了通过加强剂接种计划和强化疫苗接种策略保持高疫苗效力的必要性,以在区级维持麻疹的消除。

papers.full_text: Abstract Background Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) is a rare but always fatal neurological complication of measles, associated with persistent measles virus (MeV) infection of the central nervous system (CNS). MeV is detected in the brains of deceased SSPE patients as hypermutated viral genomes, which often contain premature stop codons in the matrix (M) gene and encode a hyperfusogenic fusion (F) protein. As a result, infected cells in the CNS cannot produce virions but rather transmit the viral ribonucleoprotein from cell-to-cell in a slow but progressive manner, which ultimately results in widespread MeV infection of the brain. However, our understanding of the pathogenesis of SSPE is constrained by the lack of animal models combined with a clinically silent incubation period of several years. Main text In a recent publication in PNAS, Daniel Roji et al. analysed animal morbillivirus sequences detected in the brains of persistently infected hosts, including a lynx (canine distemper virus, CDV), two seals (phocine distemper virus, PDV) and a dolphin (cetacean morbillivirus, CeMV). The authors describe that the morbillivirus sequences detected in these animals contained unique mutational signatures. The CDV, CeMV and one of the PDV sequences encoded nonfunctional M proteins and hyperfusogenic F proteins, reminiscent of the mutational profile of MeV detected in SSPE patients. Therefore, the authors conclude that human and animal morbilliviruses associated with chronic neurological infections share key genotypic and phenotypic traits, and that thorough analysis of naturally occurring animal morbillivirus infections could improve our understanding of SSPE pathogenesis. Conclusion The comparison of neurological complications associated with human and animal morbillivirus infections as described by Daniel Roji et al. provides a unique One Health approach to understanding the drivers of SSPE. These findings may support the development of early diagnostics or an animal model for SSPE, providing an opportunity to test novel intervention strategies. Background Measles virus (MeV), an enveloped virus with a negative strand RNA genome, is one of the most infectious viruses of humans. MeV is transmitted via the respiratory route, and uses at least two cellular receptors to infect myeloid, lymphoid and epithelial cells [1]. After an incubation time of approximately two weeks, patients develop cough, high fever and a typical skin rash. Opportunistic infections are common as a result of measles-associated immune suppression, leading to complications such as pneumonia, diarrhoea and otitis media [2]. Recovery from measles usually leads to lifelong immunity, but in rare cases MeV can persist in the central nervous system (CNS) and resurface years later as the cause of the fatal neurological complication subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) [3]. MeV belongs to the genus Morbillivirus of the family Paramyxoviridae. Several closely related animal morbilliviruses are known to cause acute disease in their respective host species, including canine distemper virus (CDV) in carnivores, phocine distemper virus (PDV) in seals, cetacean morbillivirus (CeMV) in whales and dolphins, and different morbilliviruses of bats [4, 5]. Morbilliviruses cause acute infections in immunologically naive hosts. During the early subclinical incubation stage, morbilliviruses infect myeloid and lymphoid cells by targeting the cellular receptor CD150 (SLAMF1). A cell-associated viremia rapidly leads to widespread infection of the lymphoid organs, followed by infiltration of infected immune cells into peripheral tissues. Infection of epithelial cells and keratinocytes detected late in the pathogenesis is mediated by interaction with the second cellular receptor nectin-4, a protein expressed at the adherens junction. Infection and depletion of memory immune cells leads to lymphopenia and immune amnesia, but if the adaptive system is not overwhelmed a morbillivirus-specific immune response will develop and clear the infection. However, in some cases morbilliviruses can infect and persist in the CNS. The prevalence of neurological complications differs per morbillivirus: in some host species (e.g. humans and ruminants) these are rare, whereas in others (e.g. carnivores and cetaceans) these are relatively common. The route of morbillivirus entry into the CNS remains unclear, also because neurons are receptor-negative. Nevertheless, the CNS infection persists despite high MeV-specific antibody levels in serum and cerebrospinal fluid. Currently available therapeutic options can lead to transient clinical improvement, but the outcome of the disease is always fatal. In a recent publication, Daniel Roji et al. analysed genotypic and phenotypic properties of morbilliviruses identified in the brain of different animal hosts and compared these with known properties of MeV associated with SSPE [6]. They concluded that similar evolutionary pathways across different animal species drive morbilliviruses to evolve analogous mechanisms favouring persistence in the CNS, followed by the development of chronic neurological disease [6]. This study illustrates the importance of a One Health approach for understanding the complex pathogenesis of neurological complications of measles. Properties of MeV strains detected in SSPE patients Although the route of MeV entry into the CNS remains unclear, genotypic and phenotypic analysis of MeV sequences detected in the brains of deceased SSPE patients have provided several important clues. Whereas MeV genomes detected during acute MeV infection are remarkable stable, MeV genomes detected in SSPE patients usually show biased hypermutation, often associated with ADAR1-profiles. Although the mutational profiles between MeV sequences detected in different patients are often divergent, they functionally converge in two major patterns: SSPE-associated MeV genomes encode non-functional matrix (M) proteins and hyperfusogenic fusion (F) proteins. Inactivation of the M gene can be mediated by introduction of premature stop codons, corruption of the start codon, or biased hypermutation that results in generation of a biologically inactive protein. In addition, the cytoplasmic tails of the F protein often contain mutations. Combined, this leads to a phenotype in which the generation of virus particles is impossible, as the M protein interacts with the cytoplasmic tail of F when virions bud from the cell membrane of infected cells. A second common property of SSPE-associated MeV sequences is that they encode destabilized F trimers, resulting in a hyperfusogenic phenotype. Interestingly, this often allows cell-to-cell fusion with membranes of cells that do not encode one of the high affinity cellular receptors (CD150 or nectin-4). In neurons the cell adhesion molecules CADM1 and CADM2, located at the synaptic cleft of neurons, can trigger the MeV fusion process in cis [7]. This may explain the slow but progressive spread of the MeV ribonucleoprotein (RNP) between neurons across the CNS. Animal parallels of SSPE The pathogenesis of animal morbilliviruses is similar to that of measles. As described earlier, infections of carnivores with CDV are frequently associated with acute neurological complications, which are more reminiscent of measles inclusion body encephalitis (MIBE) than SSPE. Whereas in vitro infection studies with MeV and CDV in organotypic brain slice cultures did not reveal an intrinsically higher neurotropic phenotype of CDV [8], CDV often overwhelms the adaptive immune system of the host [9, 10]. As a result, the host cannot clear the infection or prevent virus dissemination to peripheral tissues, leading to prolonged opportunities for the virus to enter the CNS. Interestingly, late neurological complications reminiscent of SSPE have been described in morbillivirus-infected dogs, dolphins and seals [11,12,13]. Old dog encephalitis is a chronic CDV encephalitis associated with severe demyelination several years after the initial infection. Like in SSPE, the causative virus cannot be isolated from brain tissue [11], despite abundant presence of viral antigen [14]. Recently, similar persistent morbillivirus infections were described in harbour seals [13] and dolphins [15]. As described by Daniel Roji et al., these veterinary cases may act as natural experiments for understanding human neuropathogenesis in the situation where animal models that reflect SSPE pathogenesis are lacking. Nonfunctional M proteins and hyperfusogenic F proteins in animal morbilliviruses Daniel Roji et al. have characterized animal morbilliviruses that persisted in the CNS of their respective host species for several years after the initial infection: CDV from a lynx, CeMV from a striped dolphin and PDV from two harbour seals stranded in 2001 or 2014 (13 and 12 years after the PDV epizootics of 1988 and 2001, respectively; strikingly similar to the interval between acute measles and the development of SSPE). The viral genomes contained complex mutational profiles with several parallels to SSPE-associated MeV genomes: biased hypermutation or premature stop codons leading to inactivation of the M protein and mutations causing F protein thermal instability and hyperfusogenicity. These findings suggest a conserved pan-morbillivirus intra-host evolutionary mechanism leading to long-term persistence in the CNS. In their study, the authors used several approaches to link the observed mutations to functional changes. They started by performing fusion assays in Vero cells in the presence or absence of expression of the relevant CD150 of seal, dolphin, dog or human origin, and demonstrated that in three out of four viruses fusion in receptor-negative cells was enhanced. Subsequently, the authors assessed the impact of hyperfusogenic F proteins on virus entry using vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) particles pseudotyped with animal morbillivirus (CDV, PDV, and CeMV) or MeV glycoproteins with truncated cytoplasmic tails, demonstrating decreased entry in CD150-expressing cells. Infection studies in CNS culture models In follow-up experiments, the authors focused on the CDV detected in a lynx and assessed the role of three mutations in the F gene on the hyperfusogenic phenotype: the authors identified a single amino acid change (P479A) that fully explained the hyperfusogenicity. Virus isolation attempts from the brain tissue of the lynx were unsuccessful. The authors therefore generated recombinant CDV strains, demonstrating that the CDV strain containing P479A was indeed attenuated in Vero-CD150 cells and could only be passaged as infected canine B-cells. Despite reduced dissemination in these lymphoid cells, the virus showed enhanced infectivity in organotypic brain slice cultures from ferrets. These observations link directly to studies previously performed with SSPE-associated MeV strains: Schmitz et al. demonstrated that a chimeric wildtype MeV with the F gene from a SSPE case was no longer lymphotropic, but instead efficiently disseminated in human neural network cultures [16]. Conclusions SSPE is a late neurological complication of measles, characterized by persistent MeV infection of the CNS. Although we have a good understanding of the pathogenesis of acute measles, and have several highly detailed case reports of the end stage of SSPE, information about progression during the clinically silent incubation time of several years is absent. Due to the lack of adequate animal models these events remain hard to study, hampering the efforts to design early diagnostic tools or identify biomarkers. The emergence of novel organoid-based brain culture models has increased options to analyze the phenotype of specific mutations, but does not provide information on whether these mutations are required for morbillivirus entry into the CNS (seeding mutations) or if these emerge during the long-term persistent CNS infection. A One Health approach to comparative pathogenesis of morbilliviruses in different host species could lead to novel options to study morbillivirus evolution and CNS persistence in natural infections, by identification of molecular signatures with predictive value. The ultimate goal of such studies would be to enable early diagnosis of persistent MeV infection of the CNS, allowing new intervention strategies using antivirals. analysis.summary_en: This study compares the central nervous system persistence of morbilliviruses across host species to better understand subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), a rare but fatal neurological complication of measles. The authors identified unique mutational signatures in animal morbilliviruses, including canine distemper virus (CDV), cetacean morbillivirus (CeMV), and one phocine distemper virus (PDV) sequence, which resemble those of measles virus (MeV) in SSPE patients. papers.full_text: Abstract The 2025 Texas measles outbreak highlighted the role of localized gaps in measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccination in sustaining transmission. In this paper, we developed a deterministic dose-structured measles model distinguishing unvaccinated, one-dose vaccinated, and two-dose vaccinated susceptible individuals, with residual susceptibility, clinical complications, and time-varying transmission. The model was calibrated by nonlinear least squares to 24 weeks of reported Texas incidence and reproduced the weekly outbreak pattern with a root mean square error of 4.7594 and a coefficient of determination of 0.9692. Under the baseline scenario of 82% total MMR coverage and 80% two-dose completion, the mean controlled reproduction number was \(R_{c,m}=1.3537\), indicating insufficient population protection for outbreak control. Under the fitted conditions, effective vaccine-induced population protection had to exceed 84.40% to reduce \(R_{c,m}\) below one, corresponding to a critical total MMR coverage of 87.74% at 80% two-dose completion. Increasing two-dose completion alone produced only modest reductions in the critical coverage, whereas increasing total MMR coverage to 90% reduced \(R_{c,m}\) below one in all completion scenarios examined. At 95% coverage and 95% two-dose completion, cumulative cases decreased by 90.66% relative to baseline. The resulting analytical framework links vaccination coverage, dose completion, dose-specific vaccine effectiveness, and transmission conditions to outbreak-control thresholds. These findings support prioritizing closure of zero-dose and overall vaccination gaps while maintaining timely two-dose MMR completion. Data availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. Code availability The MATLAB code used for model calibration, simulation, sensitivity analysis, and threshold analysis, together with the reproducibility script for the local Monte Carlo robustness analysis, is available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request. full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract The 2025 Texas measles outbreak highlighted the role of localized gaps in measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccination in sustaining transmission. In this paper, we developed a deterministic dose-structured measles model distinguishing unvaccinated, one-dose vaccinated, and two-dose vaccinated susceptible individuals, with residual susceptibility, clinical complications, and time-varying transmission. The model was calibrated by nonlinear least squares to 24 weeks of reported Texas incidence and reproduced the weekly outbreak pattern with a root mean square error of 4.7594 and a coefficient of determination of 0.9692. Under the baseline scenario of 82% total MMR coverage and 80% two-dose completion, the mean controlled reproduction number was \(R_{c,m}=1.3537\), indicating insufficient population protection for outbreak control. Under the fitted conditions, effective vaccine-induced population protection had to exceed 84.40% to reduce \(R_{c,m}\) below one, corresponding to a critical total MMR coverage of 87.74% at 80% two-dose completion. Increasing two-dose completion alone produced only modest reductions in the critical coverage, whereas increasing total MMR coverage to 90% reduced \(R_{c,m}\) below one in all completion scenarios examined. At 95% coverage and 95% two-dose completion, cumulative cases decreased by 90.66% relative to baseline. The resulting analytical framework links vaccination coverage, dose completion, dose-specific vaccine effectiveness, and transmission conditions to outbreak-control thresholds. These findings support prioritizing closure of zero-dose and overall vaccination gaps while maintaining timely two-dose MMR completion. Data availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. Code availability The MATLAB code used for model calibration, simulation, sensitivity analysis, and threshold analysis, together with the reproducibility script for the local Monte Carlo robustness analysis, is available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request. analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the 2025 Texas measles outbreak using a dose-structured model to determine vaccination coverage and dose completion thresholds necessary for outbreak control. The model was calibrated to 24 weeks of incidence data and showed that under baseline conditions, the controlled reproduction number $R_{c,m}=1.3537$, indicating insufficient protection. The research found that increasing total MMR coverage to 90% significantly reduced $R_{c,m}$ below one, regardless of two-dose completion rates. The study's framework links vaccination strategies to outbreak thresholds, supporting the prioritization of closing vaccination gaps. However, the findings are based on a model and not real-world interventions, limiting their evidence strength to moderate. The results have implications for public health by highlighting the importance of high vaccination coverage and timely dose completion in preventing measles outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 2025 年德克萨斯州 麻疹 暴发 强调了 麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹 (MMR) 疫苗接种 中局部缺口在维持 传播 中的作用。该研究旨在确定 疫苗接种 控制所需的 疫苗接种 覆盖范围和剂量完成阈值。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 开发了确定性剂量结构的 麻疹 模型,用于区分未接种疫苗、接种一剂疫苗和接种两剂疫苗的易感个体,以及残留敏感性、临床并发症和随时间变化的 传播。该模型根据 24 周报告的德克萨斯州 发病率 数据进行校准。该研究重点关注 2025 年德克萨斯州的 麻疹 暴发。
elements_zh.methods: 该模型使用非线性最小二乘法对 24 周报告的德克萨斯州 发病率 数据进行校准,再现每周 暴发 模式,均方根误差为 4.7594,确定系数为 0.9692。该框架将 疫苗接种 覆盖范围、剂量完成、剂量特异性 疫苗 有效性和 传播 条件与 暴发 控制阈值联系起来。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 MMR 总覆盖率 82% 和两剂完成 80% 的基线情景下,平均控制繁殖数为 $R_{c,m}=1.3537$,表明 暴发 控制的人群保护不足。在检查的所有完成场景中,将 MMR 总覆盖率提高到 90% 将 $R_{c,m}$ 降低到 1 以下。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,实现更高的 MMR 总覆盖率比单独增加两剂接种完成率更能有效地减少繁殖数量。该研究为理解与 疫苗接种 策略相关的 暴发 控制阈值提供了一个新颖的分析框架。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果通过强调缩小 疫苗接种 差距和确保及时完成两剂 MMR 以有效控制 麻疹 暴发 的重要性,为公共卫生策略提供信息。他们还强调需要对 疫苗接种 覆盖率低的人群进行有针对性的干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于校准模型,不包括来自现实世界干预措施的经验数据。证据强度中等,因为基于模型的研究结果受到假设和参数不确定性的影响。

papers.title: Immunopathogenetic Features of Measles in Adults: Association of Vaccination Status with Measles-Specific IgM Levels and Cytokine Profile (IL-1β, IL-10)
papers.abstract: Olha Matviiuk,1,2 Oleksandra Pryshliak,1,2 Oleksandr Boichuk,1,2 Ihor Hryzhak,1,2 Zoriana Tylishchak,1,2 Taras Kobryn,1,2 Ruslan Miziuk,1,2 Petro Gerych3,41Department of Infectious Diseases and Epidemiology, Ivano-Frankivsk National Medical University, Ivano-Frankivsk, Ukraine; 2Municipal Non-Commercial Enterprise "Center for Infectious Diseases”, Ivano-Frankivsk, Ukraine; 3Department of Internal Medicine No. 1, Clinical Immunology and Allergology Named After Academician E.M. Neiko, Ivano-Frankivsk National Medical University, Ivano-Frankivsk, Ukraine; 4Interdepartmental Scientific Laboratory, Ivano-Frankivsk National Medical University, Ivano-Frankivsk, UkraineCorrespondence: Olha Matviiuk, Department of Infectious Diseases and Epidemiology, Ivano-Frankivsk National Medical University, Ivano-Frankivsk, Ukraine, Email yaciv.olya@gmail.comBackground: The influence of prior measles vaccination on humoral and cytokine immune responses during acute measles in adults remains insufficiently characterized. This study evaluated measles-specific IgM antibody levels, the early dynamics of interleukin (IL)-1β and IL-10, and their associations with hematological parameters according to documented vaccination status.Methods: This single-center observational study included 80 adults with clinically compatible measles and positive measles-specific IgM results who were hospitalized 3– 5 days after disease onset with moderate or severe illness. Patients were classified as having documented prior measles vaccination (n = 40) or no documented evidence of prior measles vaccination (n = 40). Measles-specific IgM antibodies were measured by ELISA on day 7 after rash onset. Serum IL-1β, IL-10, total leukocyte count, and relative lymphocyte percentage were assessed at admission and on day 3 of hospitalization. Non-parametric statistical methods were applied for group comparisons and correlation analyses. An additional regression analysis was performed to assess between-group differences in IL-10 after adjustment for disease severity.Results: Patients with documented vaccination had significantly higher measles-specific IgM levels. IL-1β decreased and IL-10 increased significantly from admission to day 3 in both groups, with no between-group differences in IL-1β. In unadjusted analyses, IL-10 was higher in patients without documented vaccination at both time points. After adjustment for disease severity, the IL-10 difference at admission was no longer significant, whereas the difference on day 3 remained significant. Strong positive correlations between IL-1β and IL-10 were observed in both groups, while IgM correlated positively with relative lymphocyte percentage in patients without documented vaccination.Conclusion: Documented prior measles vaccination was associated with higher measles-specific IgM levels, while the between-group difference in IL-10 on day 3 persisted after adjustment for disease severity. IL-1β dynamics were similar between the groups. analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of prior measles vaccination on immune responses during acute measles in adults. It evaluated measles-specific IgM levels and cytokine profiles (IL-1β and IL-10) in 80 hospitalized adults with measles, divided into two groups based on vaccination status. Results showed higher IgM levels in vaccinated individuals, while IL-1β decreased and IL-10 increased in both groups. After adjusting for disease severity, the IL-10 difference on day 3 remained significant. The study highlights differences in immune-response patterns between vaccinated and unvaccinated adults, though its single-center observational design limits generalisability. These findings may contribute to understanding measles immunopathogenesis and inform future research or clinical strategies for adults with varying vaccination histories.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查成人急性 麻疹 期间先前的 麻疹 疫苗接种 对体液和细胞因子 免疫应答 的影响,因为这一点尚未充分表征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项单中心观察性研究纳入了 80 名临床上符合 麻疹 且 麻疹 特异性 IgM 结果呈阳性的成年人,他们在中度或重度疾病发作后 3-5 天住院。患者被分类为有记录的既往 麻疹 疫苗接种 (n = 40) 或没有记录的既往 麻疹 疫苗接种 证据 (n = 40)。
elements_zh.methods: 在皮疹发作后第 7 天通过 ELISA 测量 麻疹 特异性 IgM 抗体。入院时和住院第 3 天评估血清 IL-1β、IL-10、白细胞总数和相对淋巴细胞百分比。采用非参数统计方法进行组间比较和相关分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 记录有 疫苗接种 的患者的 麻疹 特异性 IgM 水平显着较高。从入院到第 3 天,两组的 IL-1β 均显着下降,IL-10 显着升高,但组间 IL-1β 没有差异。在两组中均观察到 IL-1β 和 IL-10 之间存在强正相关性,而在没有 疫苗接种 记录的患者中,IgM 与相对淋巴细胞百分比呈正相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,有记录在先的 麻疹 疫苗接种 的成年人和没有记录在案的 疫苗接种 证据的成年人之间的免疫反应模式存在差异,强调需要谨慎解释这些关联。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能有助于理解 麻疹 的免疫反应模式,可能有助于为具有不同 麻疹 病史的成年人制定有针对性的诊断或治疗策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到单中心设计和观察性质的限制,这可能会影响普遍性。由于缺乏随机性和潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,有记录在先的 麻疹 疫苗接种 的成年人和没有记录在案的 疫苗接种 证据的成年人之间的免疫反应模式存在差异,强调需要谨慎解释这些关联。

papers.title: Multiple Sclerosis and Viruses: « Liaisons Dangereuses ».
papers.abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single-pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under-researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV-1 and HSV-2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co-exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review explores the potential role of measles virus in the aetiology of multiple sclerosis (MS), focusing on its interactions with other neurotropic viruses and how these may influence MS susceptibility. The central question is whether viral co-exposures, including measles virus, act synergistically to shape MS development in genetically predisposed individuals.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a comprehensive analysis of the literature on viral interactions in MS, drawing on epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data. It does not specify particular databases or search dates, but it includes a broad range of studies examining the role of measles virus and other related viruses in MS.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that measles virus, along with other neurotropic viruses, may play a role in the development of MS through shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections. It highlights that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves multiple viral agents, not just a single pathogen.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review acknowledges that the role of measles virus in MS remains under-researched and that there is contradictory evidence regarding its specific contributions. It also notes that the mechanisms by which measles virus interacts with other pathogens to influence MS susceptibility are not yet fully understood.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that characterising viral interactions, including those involving measles virus, presents a new research direction for identifying novel biomarkers and developing preventative strategies through targeted control of viral networks.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the potential role of measles virus in the aetiology of multiple sclerosis (MS), focusing on its interactions with other neurotropic viruses. It highlights that while measles virus is one of several viral agents implicated in MS, the disease likely results from complex interactions among multiple viruses rather than a single pathogen. The review discusses the available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data, which suggest that viral co-exposures may act synergistically to influence MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. However, the specific mechanisms by which measles virus contributes to this process remain unclear, and further research is needed to characterise these interactions. The review also identifies the need for targeted research on viral networks to develop new preventative strategies and biomarkers for MS.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述探讨了 麻疹病毒 在多发性硬化症 (MS) 病因学中的潜在作用,重点关注其与其他嗜神经病毒的相互作用以及这些病毒如何影响 MS 易感性。核心问题是,包括 麻疹病毒 在内的病毒共同暴露是否会协同作用,从而影响遗传易感个体的 MS 发展。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述借鉴了流行病学、免疫学和实验数据,对多发性硬化症中病毒相互作用的文献进行了综合分析。它没有指定特定的数据库或搜索日期,但它包括检查 麻疹病毒 和其他相关病毒在多发性硬化症中的作用的广泛研究。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,麻疹病毒 以及其他嗜神经病毒可能通过共享分子途径、免疫调节和激活潜伏感染在 MS 的发展中发挥作用。它强调,从感染到自身免疫反应的转变涉及多种病毒因子,而不仅仅是单一病原体。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述承认,麻疹病毒 在 MS 中的作用仍未得到充分研究,并且关于其具体贡献的证据相互矛盾。它还指出,麻疹病毒 与其他病原体相互作用影响 MS 易感性的机制尚未完全了解。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,表征病毒相互作用,包括涉及 麻疹病毒 的病毒相互作用,为识别新型生物标志物和通过有针对性地控制病毒网络制定预防策略提供了一个新的研究方向。

analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a comprehensive analysis of the literature on viral interactions in MS, drawing on epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data. It does not specify particular databases or search dates, but it includes a broad range of studies examining the role of measles virus and other related viruses in MS.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that measles virus, along with other neurotropic viruses, may play a role in the development of MS through shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections. It highlights that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves multiple viral agents, not just a single pathogen.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review acknowledges that the role of measles virus in MS remains under-researched and that there is contradictory evidence regarding its specific contributions. It also notes that the mechanisms by which measles virus interacts with other pathogens to influence MS susceptibility are not yet fully understood.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that characterising viral interactions, including those involving measles virus, presents a new research direction for identifying novel biomarkers and developing preventative strategies through targeted control of viral networks.

papers.title_zh: 多发性硬化症和病毒:《危险关系》。
papers.source_body_en: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single-pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under-researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV-1 and HSV-2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co-exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.
papers.abstract_zh: 多发性硬化症(MS)是一种复杂的、多因素的神经退行性疾病,其病因仍部分不明。与MS发病相关的风险因素包括遗传易感性和多种环境应激因素;然而,最近病毒感染引起了广泛关注,被认为是重要的环境诱因。尽管已知EB病毒(EBV)与MS易感性之间存在明确的关联,但单一病原体模型无法清晰描述驱动该疾病分子级联反应的机制,这表明从感染到自身免疫反应的转变可能涉及不止一种病毒。在本综述中,我们探讨了不同神经嗜性病毒之间的相互作用可能在MS中发挥协同致病作用的假设,这一领域目前在文献中研究较少。我们总结了不同病毒在MS发病中作用的矛盾证据,包括疱疹病毒科(人类巨细胞病毒、EB病毒、单纯疱疹病毒HSV-1和HSV-2,以及水痘-带状疱疹病毒)、副粘病毒科(麻疹病毒病毒和风疹病毒)、流感病毒、SARS-CoV-2以及人类内源性逆转录病毒(HERVs)。这些病毒可能通过在共享分子通路中的相互作用、免疫调节以及激活潜伏感染,共同影响MS中特征性的炎症和脱髓鞘过程。本综述评估了病毒相互作用在MS病因中的作用,通过这些病原体的累积和交互效应。现有的流行病学、免疫学和实验数据表明,病毒的共同暴露可能在遗传易感个体中协同影响MS的易感性。明确这些病毒相互作用为识别新型生物标志物和通过靶向控制病毒网络开发预防策略提供了新的研究方向。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述探讨了 麻疹病毒 在多发性硬化症 (MS) 病因学中的潜在作用,重点关注其与其他嗜神经病毒的相互作用以及这些病毒如何影响 MS 易感性。核心问题是,包括 麻疹病毒 在内的病毒共同暴露是否会协同作用,从而影响遗传易感个体的 MS 发展。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述借鉴了流行病学、免疫学和实验数据,对多发性硬化症中病毒相互作用的文献进行了综合分析。它没有指定特定的数据库或搜索日期,但它包括检查 麻疹病毒 和其他相关病毒在多发性硬化症中的作用的广泛研究。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,麻疹病毒 以及其他嗜神经病毒可能通过共享分子途径、免疫调节和激活潜伏感染在 MS 的发展中发挥作用。它强调,从感染到自身免疫反应的转变涉及多种病毒因子,而不仅仅是单一病原体。

analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,表征病毒相互作用,包括涉及 麻疹病毒 的病毒相互作用,为识别新型生物标志物和通过有针对性地控制病毒网络制定预防策略提供了一个新的研究方向。

papers.title: Adverse Events Following Varicella-Containing Vaccination in Healthy Children: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.abstract: Background: Varicella-containing vaccines have substantially reduced the burden of varicella worldwide; however, comprehensive evidence on adverse events following vaccination in children remains important for vaccine safety monitoring, vaccine confidence and immunization policy. We aimed to systematically evaluate the incidence of adverse events following licensed varicella-containing vaccination in healthy children. Methods: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating monovalent varicella vaccines or measles–mumps–rubella–varicella (MMRV) vaccines in healthy children aged ≥12 months and <12 years. Eight databases were searched from 1 January 2000 to 17 July 2026. Studies using active safety monitoring and reporting extractable adverse event counts with corresponding denominators were included. Pooled incidence proportions among vaccinated children were estimated using generalized linear mixed models with random effects. Subgroup analyses were performed by vaccine type, vaccination dose, and World Health Organization region. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool, and certainty of evidence was evaluated using the GRADE approach. Results: Forty-three RCTs involving 31,915 vaccinated children were included. Fever was the most frequently reported common adverse event, with a pooled incidence of 11.58% (95% confidence interval [CI], 6.79–19.07%). Pooled incidences were 2.74% (95% CI, 1.10–6.67%) for redness/erythema, 2.19% (95% CI, 0.93–5.06%) for pain, and 0.82% (95% CI, 0.33–1.98%) for swelling. Compared with monovalent varicella vaccines, MMRV vaccines showed higher pooled incidences of fever (43.44% vs. 5.29%), redness/erythema (16.50% vs. 0.69%), pain (12.27% vs. 0.91%), and swelling (7.02% vs. 0.30%); however, these estimates were based on between-study comparisons and should not be interpreted as causal effects of vaccine type. Rare serious adverse events were uncommon, including febrile seizures (0.0989%) and anaphylaxis (0.0343%), with no observed cases of encephalitis. Conclusions: Varicella-containing vaccines were generally well tolerated in children, with most observed adverse events being uncommon and rare serious adverse events infrequently reported. Continued safety surveillance remains important, particularly for rare serious adverse events.

papers.source_body_en: Background: Varicella-containing vaccines have substantially reduced the burden of varicella worldwide; however, comprehensive evidence on adverse events following vaccination in children remains important for vaccine safety monitoring, vaccine confidence and immunization policy. We aimed to systematically evaluate the incidence of adverse events following licensed varicella-containing vaccination in healthy children. Methods: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating monovalent varicella vaccines or measles–mumps–rubella–varicella (MMRV) vaccines in healthy children aged ≥12 months and <12 years. Eight databases were searched from 1 January 2000 to 17 July 2026. Studies using active safety monitoring and reporting extractable adverse event counts with corresponding denominators were included. Pooled incidence proportions among vaccinated children were estimated using generalized linear mixed models with random effects. Subgroup analyses were performed by vaccine type, vaccination dose, and World Health Organization region. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool, and certainty of evidence was evaluated using the GRADE approach. Results: Forty-three RCTs involving 31,915 vaccinated children were included. Fever was the most frequently reported common adverse event, with a pooled incidence of 11.58% (95% confidence interval [CI], 6.79–19.07%). Pooled incidences were 2.74% (95% CI, 1.10–6.67%) for redness/erythema, 2.19% (95% CI, 0.93–5.06%) for pain, and 0.82% (95% CI, 0.33–1.98%) for swelling. Compared with monovalent varicella vaccines, MMRV vaccines showed higher pooled incidences of fever (43.44% vs. 5.29%), redness/erythema (16.50% vs. 0.69%), pain (12.27% vs. 0.91%), and swelling (7.02% vs. 0.30%); however, these estimates were based on between-study comparisons and should not be interpreted as causal effects of vaccine type. Rare serious adverse events were uncommon, including febrile seizures (0.0989%) and anaphylaxis (0.0343%), with no observed cases of encephalitis. Conclusions: Varicella-containing vaccines were generally well tolerated in children, with most observed adverse events being uncommon and rare serious adverse events infrequently reported. Continued safety surveillance remains important, particularly for rare serious adverse events.

papers.title: Splitting the Schedule: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Childhood Vaccination Completion and Timeliness With Single-Antigen Versus Combination Vaccines
papers.abstract: Description/ Abstract Recent federal policy has advanced a “split” childhood vaccine schedule, substituting single-antigen vaccines for recommended combination products, including DTaP-containing pentavalent/hexavalent vaccines and MMR. This shift warrants examination in light of current evidence on vaccine delivery in the United States. Individual cohort and survey studies have reported that combination products are associated with higher series completion and more on-time receipt of vaccination (Kurosky et al., Human Vaccines & Immunotherapeutics, 2017). More recently, an Israeli mixed-methods cohort linked single-antigen use to marked delay and non-completion (Sales et al., Vaccines, 2026). Estimates vary in magnitude, and to our knowledge, no pooled effect size exists. With resurgent measles and pertussis outbreaks driven by clustered under-vaccination, these findings have not been quantitatively synthesized. As questions on the childhood vaccine schedule increasingly arise at the point of care, pharmacists must be equipped to offer evidence-based guidance.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines the impact of substituting single-antigen vaccines for combination vaccines in the childhood vaccination schedule, focusing on measles virus and related entities. The central question is whether single-antigen vaccines affect vaccination completion and timeliness compared to combination vaccines.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of cohort and survey studies conducted in the United States. It includes both single-antigen and combination vaccine studies, with a focus on vaccine delivery methods and their effects on series completion and timeliness.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Combination vaccines are associated with higher series completion and more timely vaccination, as reported by individual cohort and survey studies (Kurosky et al., Human Vaccines & Immunotherapeutics, 2017).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Estimates of the effect of single-antigen vaccines on vaccination completion and timeliness vary in magnitude, and no pooled effect size has been reported in the evidence.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings suggest that the use of single-antigen vaccines may lead to delays and non-completion of the vaccination series, which is relevant for public health policy and clinical practice. These results highlight the need for evidence-based guidance for pharmacists and healthcare providers.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluates the impact of substituting single-antigen vaccines for combination vaccines in the childhood vaccination schedule, focusing on measles virus and related entities. The review highlights that combination vaccines are associated with higher series completion and more timely vaccination, based on cohort and survey studies in the United States. However, the evidence shows variability in the magnitude of these effects, with no pooled effect size reported. The findings suggest that the shift to single-antigen vaccines may contribute to delays and non-completion of the vaccination series, raising concerns about vaccine delivery and public health outcomes. These results emphasize the importance of evidence-based guidance for healthcare providers, particularly pharmacists, in addressing vaccine schedule-related questions at the point of care.

papers.title: Assessing the Risk for Ebola Virus Disease Outbreak and Health System Response Capacity in Conflict-Affected Sudan
papers.abstract: Background: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) is a severe viral hemorrhagic fever with high case fatality rates. Ongoing regional outbreaks in Uganda and the DRC, combined with protracted armed conflict in Sudan since April 2023, increase vulnerability to importation and spread, putting Sudan at risk. Conflict has caused widespread health infrastructure destruction, healthcare worker displacement, and disruption of surveillance and laboratory systems. This study assesses Sudan’s risk of an EVD outbreak and national response capacity in the context of conflict. Methods: We reviewed peer-reviewed and grey literature using PubMed, Medline, Google Scholar, WHO, CDC, UNICEF, and UN OCHA reports. No time restrictions were applied. We applied a SWOT analysis framework to classify factors influencing EVD prevention, detection, preparedness, and response in conflict-affected Sudan. The analysis focused on health system functionality, surveillance, laboratory capacity, workforce, and population vulnerabilities. Results: Our study found existing strengths, including availability of national EVD preparedness plans, prior experience responding to cholera, dengue, measles, and COVID-19, functional coordination through the Health Cluster, and ongoing disease surveillance systems including EWARS and Event-Based Surveillance. Weaknesses identified include severe disruption of health services (48% of facilities fully functional), health workforce shortages and burnout, disruption of laboratory capacity, and surveillance and access constraints in conflict-affected areas of Darfur and Kordofan. The ongoing health security frameworks, including the National Health Policy, National Health Sector Recovery Plan, and regional cross-border initiatives, expansion of digital surveillance, laboratory decentralization efforts, and recent international investments in health system recovery, provide significant opportunities for optimal preparedness and response. Threats identified include continued armed conflict and insecurity, large-scale internal displacement and cross-border mobility, humanitarian access constraints, and funding instability. Geographic risk synthesis indicates Darfur is at the highest risk for delayed detection and silent transmission, Kordofan serves as a transmission corridor, and Khartoum faces the highest risk of urban amplification. Conclusion: Sudan faces a moderate to high EVD outbreak risk due to potential virus importation, a conflict-weakened health system, and mass displacement. Key priorities: strengthen EWARS in conflict zones, decentralize laboratory capacity, restore health facilities with strong IPC, build workforce capacity, and adopt mobility-informed preparedness. Peace and international support remain essential for effective EVD response.

analysis.summary_en: This review assesses the risk of an Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in Sudan and evaluates the country's health system response capacity amid ongoing conflict. The study highlights the vulnerability of Sudan to EVD importation due to the destruction of health infrastructure, displacement of healthcare workers, and disruption of surveillance systems. While the review identifies strengths such as existing EVD preparedness plans and functional coordination through the Health Cluster, it also notes significant weaknesses, including limited health service functionality, workforce shortages, and challenges in surveillance and access in conflict-affected areas. The analysis emphasizes the need for strengthening digital surveillance, restoring health facilities, and building workforce capacity to enhance preparedness and response. Peace and international support are deemed critical for an effective EVD response. The review does not report specific controversies or evidence gaps related to the measles virus, but it outlines actionable research and practice implications for EVD prevention and control.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:埃博拉病毒病(EVD)是一种严重的病毒性出血热,病死率很高。乌干达和刚果民主共和国持续存在的区域性 暴发,加上苏丹自 2023 年 4 月以来旷日持久的武装冲突,增加了输入和传播的脆弱性,使苏丹面临风险。冲突造成了广泛的卫生基础设施破坏、医护人员流离失所以及 监测 和实验室系统的破坏。本研究评估了苏丹发生埃博拉病毒病 暴发 的风险以及冲突背景下的国家应对能力。方法:我们使用 PubMed、Medline、Google Scholar、WHO、CDC、UNICEF 和 UN OCHA 报告审查了同行评审的灰色文献。没有时间限制。我们应用 SWOT 分析框架对影响受冲突影响的苏丹埃博拉病毒病预防、检测、准备和应对的因素进行分类。该分析重点关注卫生系统功能、监测、实验室能力、劳动力和人口脆弱性。结果:我们的研究发现了现有优势,包括国家埃博拉病毒病防范计划的可用性、应对霍乱、登革热、麻疹 和 COVID-19 的先前经验、通过健康集群进行的功能协调以及持续疾病 监测 系统(包括 EWARS 和基于事件的 监测)。发现的弱点包括卫生服务严重中断(48%的设施功能齐全)、卫生人力短缺和倦怠、实验室能力中断以及达尔富尔和科尔多凡受冲突影响地区的 监测 和准入限制。正在进行的卫生安全框架,包括国家卫生政策、国家卫生部门恢复计划和区域跨境举措、数字 监测 的扩展、实验室权力下放工作以及最近对卫生系统恢复的国际投资,为最佳准备和应对提供了重要机会。已确定的威胁包括持续的武装冲突和不安全、大规模境内流离失所和跨境流动、人道主义准入限制以及资金不稳定。地理风险综合表明,达尔富尔面临延迟检测和沉默 传播 的最高风险,科尔多凡充当 传播 走廊,喀土穆面临城市放大的最高风险。结论:由于潜在的病毒输入、因冲突而被削弱的卫生系统和大规模流离失所,苏丹面临着中度至高度的埃博拉病毒病 暴发 风险。主要优先事项:加强冲突地区的 EWARS、分散实验室能力、通过强大的 IPC 恢复卫生设施、建设劳动力能力以及采取流动性知情的准备。和平和国际支持对于有效应对埃博拉病毒病仍然至关重要。

papers.title: Microneedle-Based Transdermal Drug Delivery: Recent Advances and Future Prospects
papers.abstract: Microneedle (MN) systems are emerging as versatile platforms that create micron-scale pathways across the stratum corneum while limiting stimulation of deeper pain receptors and blood vessels. This minimally invasive approach expands transdermal delivery beyond the small, moderately lipophilic molecules traditionally suited to passive patches and enables administration of peptides, proteins, vaccines, poorly soluble drugs, nucleic-acid formulations and locally acting dermatological agents. This review critically examines solid, coated, hollow, dissolving, separable and hydrogel-forming microneedles, with emphasis on how material selection, needle geometry, drug localization and manufacturing method determine insertion reliability, dose capacity, release kinetics and product stability. Recent advances include pure-drug needle tips for high payloads, nanosuspension-loaded dissolving arrays for lipophilic molecules, hydrogel-forming systems coupled with engineered reservoirs, rapidly separating tips for sustained intradermal depots, and additive manufacturing for rapid design optimization. Clinical evidence from influenza, measles-rubella and osteoporosis programmes confirms the translational potential of microarray patches, although local reactions, dose delivery variability and scale-up remain important constraints. Critical quality attributes include morphology, mechanical strength, insertion depth, drug content and distribution, dissolution or swelling, permeation, sterility assurance, packaging integrity and user-applied force. Future progress will depend on integrated quality-by-design development, robust in vitro-in vivo relationships, climate-resilient packaging, human-factor engineering and clearer combination-product regulatory pathways. Microneedles are therefore positioned not merely as an alternative to injections, but as a programmable interface for localized, systemic and responsive therapy.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the potential of microneedle (MN) systems as a transdermal drug delivery platform, emphasizing their ability to deliver a wide range of therapeutic agents beyond traditional small molecules. The analysis covers various MN types, including solid, coated, hollow, dissolving, separable, and hydrogel-forming, highlighting how material selection, geometry, and manufacturing influence performance. Recent advancements such as pure-drug tips, nanosuspension-loaded dissolving arrays, and additive manufacturing are noted, along with clinical evidence from influenza, measles-rubella, and osteoporosis programs. Despite their promise, challenges like local reactions, dose variability, and scale-up persist. The review also identifies critical quality attributes and outlines future directions, including quality-by-design approaches, in vitro-in vivo relationships, and regulatory clarity. Microneedles are positioned as a programmable interface for localized and systemic therapy, offering a transformative alternative to injections.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 微针 (MN) 系统正在成为一种多功能平台,可以在角质层上创建微米级的通路,同时限制对更深的疼痛感受器和血管的刺激。这种微创方法将透皮递送扩展到传统上适合被动贴剂的小、中等亲脂性分子之外,并能够施用肽、蛋白质、疫苗、难溶性药物、核酸制剂和局部作用的皮肤病药物。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述严格审查了实心、涂层、空心、溶解、可分离和水凝胶形成的微针,重点是材料选择、针几何形状、药物定位和制造方法如何决定插入可靠性、剂量容量、释放动力学和产品稳定性。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 最新进展包括用于高有效负载的纯药物针尖、用于亲脂性分子的纳米悬浮液负载溶解阵列、与工程 储存宿主 相结合的水凝胶形成系统、用于持续皮内储库的快速分离针尖以及用于快速设计优化的增材制造。来自流感、麻疹-风疹和骨质疏松症项目的临床证据证实了微阵列贴片的转化潜力,尽管局部反应、剂量输送变异性和扩大规模仍然是重要的限制因素。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关键质量属性包括形态、机械强度、插入深度、药物含量和分布、溶解或膨胀、渗透、无菌保证、包装完整性和用户施加的力。未来的进展将取决于综合的质量设计开发、强大的体外体内关系、气候适应性包装、人因工程和更清晰的组合产品监管途径。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 因此,微针不仅可以作为注射的替代品,而且可以作为局部、全身和响应性治疗的可编程接口。

papers.title: HVSnp: A manually curated database of human SNPS associated with viral infections.
papers.abstract: Abstract We developed the “HVSnp: Human Viruses SNP-related database, a curated database”. HVSnp is exclusive to the human SNPs studied and related to viral diseases, with manually mined and curated information from public SNP databases and scientific articles. We used MySQL (version 8.0) due to the easy management and the Looker Studio online availability. Among the output information, we have SNP identification, reference, alternative, and risk alleles, chromosome, gene, and gene function, summary, among others. In total, HVSnp contains eighteen viral diseases and 2020 records: Adenovirus (17 SNPs), Chikungunya (7), COVID-19 (314), Cytomegalovirus (54), Dengue (62), Epstein-Barr (54), Hepatitis A (3), Hepatitis B (380), Hepatitis C (166), Herpes (8), Human immunodeficiency virus (479), Papillomavirus (87), Influenza (74), Measles (68), Respiratory syncytial virus (50), Sars-CoV (80), West Nile (68), and Zika (49). As one SNP can be associated with more than one virus, the number of unique SNPs is 1691 and 651 genes. HVSnp has supplementary information obtained in articles for the summary elaboration, which contains the most significant results described in the literature about a possible relationship between SNPs and viruses. The database is available at URL: https://lookerstudio.google.com/s/pGUC7m538gQ.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a curated database of human SNPs associated with viral infections, addressing the need for a comprehensive resource to understand the genetic basis of viral diseases.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the creation of HVSnp, a database containing 2020 records of SNPs related to 18 viral diseases, including measles, using manual curation from public SNP databases and scientific articles.
analysis.methods: HVSnp was developed using MySQL (version 8.0) for database management and Looker Studio for online availability.
analysis.main_results: HVSnp includes SNP identification, reference, alternative, and risk alleles, chromosome, gene, and gene function, with a total of 1691 unique SNPs and 651 genes.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The database provides supplementary information from articles to elaborate on the most significant results about the relationship between SNPs and viruses, highlighting the potential genetic basis of viral diseases.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: HVSnp can inform surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment of viral diseases by providing a comprehensive resource for understanding the genetic factors associated with these infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the manual curation process and the potential for bias in the selection of SNPs and viruses, which may affect the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the database.

analysis.summary_en: HVSnp is a curated database of human SNPs associated with viral infections, including 18 diseases such as measles. It provides detailed SNP information and supplementary literature to enhance understanding of genetic factors in viral diseases.

papers.title: Analytical Validation of MethyLiverDx-Sigma, a Plasma cfDNA Methylation Assay for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Detection.
papers.abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance relies on ultrasonography and alpha-fetoprotein, both limited in sensitivity for early-stage disease; aberrant methylation of circulating cell-free DNA (cfDNA) offers a promising blood-based approach. Reported here is the analytical validation of MethyLiverDx-Sigma (MLDx-s), an assay that detects methylated RNF135 and DNMT3A in bisulfite-converted plasma cfDNA by methylation-specific PCR with high-resolution melting (HRM), with GAPDH as an endogenous control. Performance was evaluated following CLSI EP05-A3, EP07, EP12-A2, and EP37. Precision of quantification cycle (Cq) and melting peak temperature (Tm) was assessed by variance-component analysis within one site and across two sites and two operators. Because precision studies used bulk bisulfite-converted reference DNA, the reported coefficients of variation (CVs) primarily characterize the PCR-HRM detection module; end-to-end variability in clinical plasma specimens may be higher. Interference and cross-reactivity were evaluated in low-positive and contrived-negative samples against reproducibility-derived limits, with dose-response testing of reactive substances. Detection was 100% at both levels, and every run met control-validity criteria. Cq repeatability CVs ranged from 0.53% to 1.68%, and total reproducibility CVs ranged from 1.10% to 2.37%; all Tm CVs were ≤0.20%. All 18 interferents and 16 microbial cross-reactants evaluated in low-positive samples met the predefined acceptance criteria. In negative samples, hemoglobin, SARS-CoV-2, and measles virus produced concentration-dependent non-specific amplification, and dose-response testing established their respective no-effect concentrations. These findings characterize the analytical precision and multisite reproducibility of the PCR-HRM detection module and the analytical specificity of MLDx-s, complementing its previously reported clinical performance for plasma-based HCC detection.

analysis.main_results: Cq repeatability coefficients of variation (CVs) ranged from 0.53% to 1.68%, and total reproducibility CVs ranged from 1.10% to 2.37%. All Tm CVs were ≤0.20%. Additionally, all 18 interferents and 16 microbial cross-reactants met predefined acceptance criteria.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide a foundation for the use of MLDx-s in HCC surveillance, offering a more sensitive and specific alternative to current methods such as ultrasonography and alpha-fetoprotein, which are limited in early detection.

analysis.summary_en: This study validates MethyLiverDx-Sigma (MLDx-s), a plasma cfDNA methylation assay for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) detection. It highlights the limitations of current HCC surveillance methods, such as ultrasonography and alpha-fetoprotein, which are less sensitive for early-stage disease. The analytical validation followed CLSI guidelines and included precision and reproducibility assessments across multiple sites and operators. Results showed low coefficients of variation for quantification cycle (Cq) and melting peak temperature (Tm), with all interferents and cross-reactants meeting predefined criteria. These findings establish the analytical precision and specificity of MLDx-s, supporting its potential as a more effective tool for HCC detection. However, the study did not evaluate end-to-end variability in clinical specimens, which may affect real-world performance. The evidence is moderate due to the abstract-only nature of the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在验证一种利用循环游离 DNA (cfDNA) 异常甲基化检测肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的血液检测方法,解决超声检查和甲胎蛋白等现有方法不足以进行早期疾病检测的局限性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及 MethyLiverDx-Sigma (MLDx-s) 的分析验证,该方法使用具有高分辨率熔解 (HRM) 的甲基化特异性 PCR 来检测血浆 cfDNA 中的甲基化 RNF135 和 DNMT3A。验证遵循 CLSI 指南,包括跨多个站点和操作员的精度和可重复性评估。
elements_zh.methods: MLDx-s 的分析验证是使用 CLSI EP05-A3、EP07、EP12-A2 和 EP37 指南进行的。通过一个站点内以及两个站点和两个操作员之间的方差分量分析来评估定量周期 (Cq) 和熔解峰温度 (Tm) 的精度。
elements_zh.main_results: Cq 重复性变异系数 (CV) 范围为 0.53% 至 1.68%,总再现性 CV 范围为 1.10% 至 2.37%。所有 Tm CV 均≤0.20%。此外,所有 18 种干扰物和 16 种微生物交叉反应物均符合预定的验收标准。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果为 MLDx-s 在 HCC 监测 中的使用奠定了基础,为早期检测有限的现有方法(例如超声检查和甲胎蛋白)提供了更灵敏和特异的替代方法。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的重点是使用参考 DNA 进行分析验证,并未评估临床血浆样本的端到端变异性,这可能会带来额外的不确定性。由于研究结果仅具有抽象性,因此证据强度中等。

papers.title: Modeling Endemic Disease Control Under Conflict Constraints: Regional Government Capacity to Reach Populations Isolated by Warfare in Sudan
papers.abstract: Armed conflict significantly disrupts public health systems, yet the mechanisms linking violence to endemic disease outbreaks remain insufficiently understood. This study examines how violent conflict affects disease governance and health service delivery across Sudan’s conflict-affected regions between 2000 and 2024. Using a spatial panel dataset that combines geo-referenced conflict events from the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data Project (ACLED), epidemiological surveillance records, environmental indicators, and subnational governance measures, the analysis evaluates the relationship between conflict intensity, governance capacity, and endemic disease incidence. The results indicate that areas experiencing higher levels of violence exhibit significantly greater incidence of malaria, cholera, and measles. These effects are particularly pronounced where health infrastructure has been damaged and administrative capacity has weakened. Regions with stronger local governance demonstrate greater resilience, maintaining partial vaccination coverage and disease surveillance despite ongoing conflict. Spatial models further reveal significant spillover effects, with outbreaks spreading along displacement corridors and border regions. The findings highlight the central role of governance capacity in mediating health outcomes during armed conflict and underscore the importance of conflict-sensitive health interventions. Strengthening decentralized health governance, protecting health infrastructure, and improving cross-regional disease surveillance are essential for mitigating endemic disease risks in fragile and conflict-affected settings.
papers.journal: International Journal of Business Ecosystem and Strategy (2687-2293)

papers.title: Exploring enablers and barriers for implementing community-based surveillance strengthening early detection and response in District Mardan Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Pakistan
papers.abstract: Community-based surveillance (CBS) compliments early warning alert and response beyond health facilities by identifying events at source through community engagement, enabling detection of disease outbreaks before facility-based reporting systems. In Pakistan, repeated outbreaks of dengue, measles and other infectious diseases highlight the need for event detection at community level. Although community-based surveillance is globally advocated, implementation at district level remains limited. Successful CBS implementation depends on understanding local contexts, stakeholder readiness, and enabling factors. Before implementing CBS in District Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, this qualitative study assesses implementation readiness by exploring multi-stakeholder perspectives on barriers and enablers. The study engages district health officials, Lady Health Workers, facility staff, and community volunteers to identify contextual factors and strategies needed for effective community participation in outbreak detection and response systems. A qualitative exploratory study was conducted from June to August 2025 in District Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. We conducted five key informant interviews (KIIs) with district officials (DHO, Provincial Coordinator, 3 program managers/officers) and three focus group discussions (FGDs) stratified by stakeholder role including Lady Health Workers (LHWs, n = 17), health facility staff (HFS, n = 13), and community volunteers (CV, n = 15) totaling n = 50 participants. Data were collected using semi-structured guides, audio-recorded with consent, transcribed and analyzed using both inductive and deductive coding in NVivo 12. Data triangulation across four stakeholder groups strengthened credibility of findings. CBS was perceived a value addition in identification of events and to compliment early warning alerts and response component of national surveillance system. Community alerts often go undocumented. Participants described perceived gaps in LHW coverage, particularly in peri-urban and remote areas. Strengthening of CBS implementation included motivated frontline workers, strong community engagement and increasing use of digital tools. Challenges included passive reporting, limited training, weak data integration, and mistrust in vaccination campaigns. Participants recommended revitalizing village health committees, unified real-time reporting, continuous training, and stronger feedback mechanisms. CBS in Mardan provides a promising foundation but remains fragmented. Expanding LHW coverage, strengthening reporting systems, and rebuilding trust with communities are key steps toward more effective early detection and response.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究的重点是实施基于社区的 监测 (CBS),以早期发现和应对传染病,包括巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省马尔丹区的 麻疹。核心问题是关于 CBS 实施的准备情况,特别是在确定社区有效参与 暴发 检测和响应系统的障碍和推动因素方面。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究是一项定性探索性研究,于 2025 年 6 月至 8 月在巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省马尔丹区进行。数据是通过与地区官员进行的五次关键知情人访谈 (KII) 以及按利益相关者角色分层的三场焦点小组讨论 (FGD) 收集的,包括女性卫生工作者 (LHW,n = 17)、卫生机构工作人员 (HFS,n = 13) 和社区志愿者 (CV,n = 15),总共 n = 50 名参与者。使用 NVivo 12 中的归纳和演绎编码对数据进行分析,并对四个利益相关者群体进行数据三角测量,以增强研究结果的可信度。

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 为了提高CBS的有效性,研究建议振兴村卫生委员会,实施统一的实时报告系统,为一线工作人员提供持续培训,并建立更强有力的反馈机制。这些步骤对于提高该地区的早期检测和响应能力至关重要。

In Pakistan, repeated outbreaks of dengue, measles and other infectious diseases highlight the need for event detection at community level. Although community-based surveillance is globally advocated, implementation at district level remains limited. Successful CBS implementation depends on understanding local contexts, stakeholder readiness, and enabling factors. Before implementing CBS in District Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, this qualitative study assesses implementation readiness by exploring multi-stakeholder perspectives on barriers and enablers. The study engages district health officials, Lady Health Workers, facility staff, and community volunteers to identify contextual factors and strategies needed for effective community participation in outbreak detection and response systems. A qualitative exploratory study was conducted from June to August 2025 in District Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. We conducted five key informant interviews (KIIs) with district officials (DHO, Provincial Coordinator, 3 program managers/officers) and three focus group discussions (FGDs) stratified by stakeholder role including Lady Health Workers (LHWs, n = 17), health facility staff (HFS, n = 13), and community volunteers (CV, n = 15) totaling n = 50 participants. Data were collected using semi-structured guides, audio-recorded with consent, transcribed and analyzed using both inductive and deductive coding in NVivo 12. Data triangulation across four stakeholder groups strengthened credibility of findings. CBS was perceived a value addition in identification of events and to compliment early warning alerts and response component of national surveillance system. Community alerts often go undocumented. Participants described perceived gaps in LHW coverage, particularly in peri-urban and remote areas. Strengthening of CBS implementation included motivated frontline workers, strong community engagement and increasing use of digital tools. Challenges included passive reporting, limited training, weak data integration, and mistrust in vaccination campaigns. Participants recommended revitalizing village health committees, unified real-time reporting, continuous training, and stronger feedback mechanisms. CBS in Mardan provides a promising foundation but remains fragmented. Expanding LHW coverage, strengthening reporting systems, and rebuilding trust with communities are key steps toward more effective early detection and response.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于社区的 监测 (CBS) 通过社区参与从源头识别事件,从而在基于设施的报告系统之前检测到疾病 暴发,从而补充医疗机构以外的早期预警警报和响应。在巴基斯坦,登革热、麻疹 和其他传染病的反复出现凸显了在社区层面进行事件检测的必要性。尽管基于社区的 监测 在全球范围内得到倡导,但地区层面的实施仍然有限。CBS 的成功实施取决于对当地情况、利益相关者的准备情况和有利因素的了解。在开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省马尔丹区实施 CBS 之前,这项定性研究通过探讨多方利益相关者对障碍和促成因素的观点来评估实施准备情况。该研究涉及地区卫生官员、女性卫生工作者、设施工作人员和社区志愿者,以确定社区有效参与 暴发 检测和响应系统所需的背景因素和策略。2025 年 6 月至 8 月在巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省马尔丹区进行了一项定性探索性研究。我们对地区官员(DHO、省协调员、3 名项目经理/官员)进行了 5 次关键知情人访谈 (KII),并根据利益相关者角色进行了 3 次焦点小组讨论 (FGD),其中包括女性保健工作者 (LHW,n = 17)、卫生机构工作人员 (HFS,n = 13) 和社区志愿者 (CV,n = 15),总共 n = 50 名参与者。使用半结构化指南收集数据,在同意的情况下进行录音,并使用 NVivo 12 中的归纳和演绎编码进行转录和分析。四个利益相关者群体之间的数据三角测量增强了研究结果的可信度。CBS 被认为在识别事件以及补充国家 监测 系统的预警警报和响应组件方面具有附加值。社区警报通常没有记录。参与者描述了 LHW 覆盖范围的感知差距,特别是在城郊和偏远地区。加强 CBS 实施包括积极主动的一线工作人员、强有力的社区参与以及增加数字工具的使用。挑战包括被动报告、有限的培训、数据集成薄弱以及对 疫苗接种 活动的不信任。与会者建议振兴村卫生委员会、统一实时报告、持续培训、加强反馈机制。马尔丹的哥伦比亚广播公司提供了一个有希望的基础,但仍然支离破碎。扩大 LHW 覆盖范围、加强报告系统以及重建与社区的信任是实现更有效的早期发现和应对的关键步骤。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究的重点是实施基于社区的 监测 (CBS),以早期发现和应对传染病,包括巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省马尔丹区的 麻疹。核心问题是关于 CBS 实施的准备情况,特别是在确定社区有效参与 暴发 检测和响应系统的障碍和推动因素方面。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究是一项定性探索性研究,于 2025 年 6 月至 8 月在巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省马尔丹区进行。数据是通过与地区官员进行的五次关键知情人访谈 (KII) 以及按利益相关者角色分层的三场焦点小组讨论 (FGD) 收集的,包括女性卫生工作者 (LHW,n = 17)、卫生机构工作人员 (HFS,n = 13) 和社区志愿者 (CV,n = 15),总共 n = 50 名参与者。使用 NVivo 12 中的归纳和演绎编码对数据进行分析,并对四个利益相关者群体进行数据三角测量,以增强研究结果的可信度。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 基于社区的 监测 (CBS) 被认为是识别事件和补充国家 监测 系统的早期预警和响应组件的增值功能。然而,CBS 在马尔丹的实施仍然支离破碎,凸显了加强报告系统、增加 LHW 覆盖范围以及重建社区信任的必要性。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究指出了被动报告、有限的培训、数据集成薄弱以及对 疫苗接种 活动的不信任等挑战。缺乏记录的社区警报,并且 LHW 覆盖范围存在差距,特别是在城郊和偏远地区。这些问题表明 CBS 实施中存在尚未解决的机制和证据差距。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 为了提高CBS的有效性,研究建议振兴村卫生委员会,实施统一的实时报告系统,为一线工作人员提供持续培训,并建立更强有力的反馈机制。这些步骤对于提高该地区的早期检测和响应能力至关重要。
